scraped.scraped_description: Understand your audience using open data. Paste in your audience's postcodes or output areas to get started.

name: OpenAudience
tagline: Understand your audience using open data by analyzing postcodes and output areas
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Proprietary platform dependent on UK postcode and census data availability

academic_citations.title: A prospective report on the research developed at the Laboratory of Audio and Music Technology at USP

documented_limitations: Postcode data privacy claims stated but not independently verified
political_relevance_summary: OpenAudience addresses the need for demographic and geographic audience understanding using open data, supporting campaigners and advocacy groups in targeting and understanding their constituencies.

movement_building_utility.notes: OpenAudience directly enables organizing by providing tools for collective action, campaigning, or community mobilization.

generalizability_notes: Limited generalizability. OpenAudience is proprietary and designed for UK-specific contexts. The concept could inspire similar efforts elsewhere but direct replication is not feasible.
